# Pragmatic Sysadmin
> Pragmatic sysadmin guides, server troubleshooting checklists, senior tech family support, and free interactive browser tools by Jonne, a Finnish systems administrator.

## Free Browser-Based Administrative Tools
Interactive tools running 100% client-side in the browser with zero tracking:

- [Command Simulator](https://pragmaticsysadmin.help/tools/command-simulator.html): Simulate and practice dangerous Linux and Windows commands (rm -rf, dd, chmod) safely in-browser.
- [AI Prompt Builder for Sysadmins](https://pragmaticsysadmin.help/tools/ai-prompt-builder.html): Generate precision prompts for ChatGPT, Claude, and Copilot tailored to bash scripts and cloud infra.
- [CLI Adventure](https://pragmaticsysadmin.help/tools/cli-adventure.html): Gamified terminal simulation solving realistic production IT incidents.
- [Password Strength Checker](https://pragmaticsysadmin.help/tools/password-checker.html): Client-side password security analysis with entropy calculation and zero data transmission.
- [Pragmatic Pulse Resilience Scorecard](https://pragmaticsysadmin.help/tools/pulse.html): Digital resilience audit assessing backups, credential hygiene, and disaster recovery readiness.
- [PowerShell & Bash Script Generator](https://pragmaticsysadmin.help/tools/script-generator.html): Interactive generator for production-ready administrative scripts across Linux and Windows.
- [Homelab Architect & Spec Calculator](https://pragmaticsysadmin.help/tools/homelab-architect.html): Interactive sizing calculator for self-hosted home labs: CPU cores, RAM allocation, and storage.
- [Battle Station Score](https://pragmaticsysadmin.help/tools/battle-station-score.html): Interactive ergonomics, peripherals, and desk setup rater providing custom upgrade tips.
- [Tech Needs Advisor](https://pragmaticsysadmin.help/tools/tech-needs-advisor.html): Decision tree recommending hardware and software configurations for students and pros.
- [Corporate Translator & Incident Report Generator](https://pragmaticsysadmin.help/tools/corporate-translator.html): Convert plain-English postmortems and IT outages into formal corporate status communications.
- [Plain English Tech Explainer](https://pragmaticsysadmin.help/tools/plain-english.html): Translate cryptic system errors and log stacktraces into understandable non-technical language.
- [PRISM Architecture Simulator](https://pragmaticsysadmin.help/tools/prism-engine.html): Interactive simulation playground for distributed systems failure modes and failover.

This practical guide covers hardware recommendations, essential software, and step-by-step setup instructions.

Learn how to set up effective alerts that actually work, reduce false positives, and catch problems before your users start complaining
- [The 5-Minute Server Health Check That Could Save Your Career](https://pragmaticsysadmin.help/sysadmin/2025-12-09-the-5-minute-server-health-check-that-could-save-your-career/): A simple daily ritual that every sysadmin should master to catch problems before they become emergencies.

Build your own minimal Linux system from scratch and test it instantly using containers - no VMs required.

Now we're going deeper: compile our own kernel from source, strip it under 10MB, replace the hand-rolled init with systemd, and run a real SSH service.
